legiones.actionText: Move Again. Player must move to an accessible Tile. Cannot complete missions or transact on this Tile before proceeding.

legiones.name: Marcus Julius Gessius Marcianus
legiones.bio: Married to Julia Mamaea. Father of Severus Alexander.
legiones.actionText: ?: Move again this turn

nefarii.name: Aelius Herodianus
nefarii.bio: Celebrated grammarian whose treatises on Greek accentuation were prized by Domna's learned circle.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me your cheapest Good (if Player has no goods, no demand)

nefarii.name: Marcus Antonius Gordianus
nefarii.bio: Would become Emperor Gordian II for twenty-two days in 238. Killed at the Battle of Carthage.
nefarii.actionText: !: Give me (R) Influence Cards (Can give all Cards to take thumbs-down and no Combat)

nefarii.name: Salve!
nefarii.actionText: Temporarily receive +1 factional reputation for your next encounter. Draw again.

nefarii.name: Carpophorus
nefarii.bio: Famed Roman bestiarius celebrated for slaying twenty wild beasts in a single arena spectacle.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Animals. (if Player has no Animals, no demand)

nefarii.name: Gaius Sempronius Rufus
nefarii.bio: Notorious eunuch, street poisoner, and palace informer exiled to an island by Severus.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me 6(d) (Can give all (d) to take thumbs-down and no Combat)

nefarii.name: Smuggler
nefarii.bio: This procurer of rare goods works for Julia Domna.
nefarii.actionText: ?: Will Sell any one Good from Goods Deck at + (relative to Present Mkt Scarcity)

mission.item: Any one Good from Goods Deck

nefarii.name: Maximinus Thrax
nefarii.bio: Thracian recruit, famous for out-wrestling whole cohorts in camp games; Emperor in 235.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Influence Cards (if Player has no Cards, no demand)

nefarii.name: Bato
nefarii.bio: Caracalla commanded Bato to fight three gladiators consecutively, then rewarded him with a magnificent funeral.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Cheap Wine (if Player has no Cheap W, no demand)

nefarii.name: Bulla Felix
nefarii.bio: Legendary 'Robin Hood' bandit captain of 600 brigands. Betrayed by his mistress and thrown to wild beasts.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me your cheapest Good (if Player has no goods, no demand)

nefarii.name: Fulvius Plautius Hortensianus
nefarii.bio: Son of the executed prefect Plautianus and brother of Fulvia Plautilla. Caracalla orders both siblings strangled.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Cash. (if Player has no Cash, no demand)

nefarii.name: Gannys
nefarii.bio: Shrewd palace operative.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me (R) Influence Cards (Can give all Cards and take thumbs-down and no Combat)

nefarii.name: Theocritus
nefarii.bio: Former slave and Roman pantomime dancer who taught Caracalla to dance.
nefarii.actionText: ?: Will Sell one Marble from Mkt at > Scarcity

nefarii.name: Tiberius Clodius Pupienus Pulcher Maximus
nefarii.bio: Consul suffectus in 224.
nefarii.actionText: Pick up cheapest Wine on Mkt in F6 and deliver to E3. (highest present Sell Price) (if no Wine on Mkt, no mission)

nefarii.name: Serapion
nefarii.bio: Underground Egyptian astrologer.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me (R) Influence Cards (Can give all Cards and take thumbs-down and no Combat)

nefarii.name: Subura Cutthroat
nefarii.bio: Hired blade.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me your cheapest Good (if Player has no goods, no demand)

nefarii.name: Euprepes
nefarii.bio: Celebrated Roman charioteer who crowned 782 Circus victories. Marked for death by Caracalla solely because he raced for Geta's preferred faction.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me (R) Influence Cards (Can give all cards to take thumbs-down and no Combat)

nefarii.name: Brutta Figura
nefarii.actionText: Temporarily receive -1 factional reputation for your next encounter. Draw again.

nefarii.name: Suppositicius
nefarii.bio: Fresh arena substitute gladiator thrown in against an exhausted Bato during Caracalla's rigged spectacle; Geta's partisans backed him out of spite.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Meat Animals (if Player has no Meat A, no demand)

nefarii.name: Fulvia Plautilla
nefarii.bio: Estranged wife of Caracalla. Banished to Lipara after her father's execution. Ordered strangled in 211.
nefarii.actionText: Pick up Pugiones in A5 and deliver to D5

nefarii.name: Coeranus
nefarii.bio: Egyptian equestrian confidant of Plautianus exiled to an island in 205.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me (R) Influence Cards (Can give all cards to take thumbs-down and no Combat)

nefarii.name: Flamma
nefarii.bio: Fought 34 bouts, won 21, refused the wooden rudis of freedom four times. Died in the arena at age 30.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Wine (if Player has no Wine, no demand)

nefarii.name: Euodus
nefarii.bio: Engineered the palace trap against Plautianus. Nonetheless executed by Caracalla in late 211.
nefarii.actionText: ?: Will Sell one Exotic A from Mkt at > Scarcity

nefarii.name: Lupanar Procurer
nefarii.bio: Brothel-keeper.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me all of your Marble (if Player has no Marble, no demand)

nefarii.name: Saturninus
nefarii.bio: Nocturnal courier.
nefarii.actionText: ?: Will Buy one Wine at = Scarcity

nefarii.name: Herodian Of Antioch
nefarii.bio: Minor imperial freedman-clerk in 211. Author of Herodian's Roman History.
nefarii.actionText: !: Give me all of your Fine Wine (if Player has no Fine W, no demand)

nefarii.name: Epagathus
nefarii.bio: Palace enforcer.
nefarii.actionText: !!: Give me 4(d) (Can give all (d) to take thumbs-down and no Combat)

nefarii.name: Road Blocked
nefarii.actionText: Turn Around. Player must move to previously-occupied Tile and end turn. If edge encounter, stay on present tile. If first turn, remove cart from board; can pick any entry gate next turn.

nefarii.name: Emporium Dock-Thief
nefarii.bio: Riverfront smuggling gang.
nefarii.actionText: ?: Will Buy one Wine at = Scarcity

nefarii.name: Poacher
nefarii.bio: Purveyor of fine contraband.
nefarii.actionText: ?: Will Sell one Exotic A from Mkt at > Scarcity
